# Client Data Analyst

EDINBURGH, MIDLOTHIAN, United Kingdom

Apply Now

## Job Information

- Job Identification210740918
- Job CategoryClient Operations Management
- Business UnitAsset & Wealth Management
- Locations3 Lochside View, Edinburgh, EH12 9DH, GB
- Job ScheduleFull time

## Job Description

Are you passionate about supporting high net worth clients? Join us to execute requests end-to-end with strong risk discipline.

As a Client Operations Analyst in Asset Wealth Management Team, you’ll be at the heart of that work—partnering with bankers and teams across finance, technology, compliance, and operations on a global platform. Designed for early‑career talent, this role offers real responsibility from day one, hands‑on learning, and exposure to how Private Banking works end to end. You’ll help deliver client requests, manage operational processes, and support high‑quality, compliant outcomes in a fast‑moving, collaborative environment.

You’ll succeed if you’re detail‑driven, organized, and confident working with a wide range of stakeholders—someone who enjoys problem‑solving, juggling priorities, and making an impact early in your career.

**Job responsibilities**

- Build strong relationships with bankers and partners across legal, technology, and change teams, communicating clearly and confidently in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
- Execute client activity end‑to‑end with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and client experience, anticipating needs and coordinating seamless delivery.
- Spot opportunities to simplify and improve processes, contributing ideas that reduce friction and make a real difference for clients and colleagues.
- Take ownership of your development—setting goals, seeking feedback, and building new skills—while contributing positively to team culture and diversity & inclusion.
- Apply sound judgement and uphold the highest standards of integrity, handling sensitive information with discretion and care.
- Operate with strong risk discipline by following policies, staying current with regulation, and supporting a robust control environment.
- Escalate issues promptly and professionally to help identify risks early and protect client trust.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

- Strong attention to detail and a natural instinct for accuracy and quality.
- Ability to manage competing priorities with organization, accountability, and resilience.
- Clear, professional communication skills (written and verbal), with the confidence to engage with a broad range of stakeholders.
- Demonstrated integrity, good judgement, and respect for confidentiality.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities , and skills**

- Fluency in German, French, Spanish or Italian is beneficial but not essential.
- Interest in, or exposure to, process improvement or project delivery (formal experience welcomed but not required).

## About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world’s most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our [FAQs](https://careers.jpmorgan.com/us/en/how-we-hire/faqs) for more information about requesting an accommodation.


## About the Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.​
